geometry_procrustes_linearity.application: On four independent test panels per checkpoint, the largest change after refining the rank grid was 0.01299. The canonical 100-passage study sample has 51 articles and zero overlap at both splits. Across 65 checkpoints and 11 held-out labs, adding R² to log size and four BPBs increased equal-lab MAE from 0.09205 to 0.09594. Four labs improved. The alternate-stack Qwen3-8B score agreed exactly.
geometry_procrustes_linearity.next_check: An independent lab cohort and a prospectively chosen target are needed for a new predictive claim. Retain the training-selected cutoff and report both document splits.

procrustes_linearity_heldout_r2_mean.scope: An inner document split selects each truncated-SVD cutoff above the float32 covariance floor. Independent NumPy fits check learned ranks, null directions, repeated rows and refitting on all outer training documents. Changing the outer targets leaves the selected ranks unchanged. Grouped-document public evaluations check native and NumPy parent IDs. A separate 100-passage study replay on Transformers 5.23.0 verified both splits against the original articles through the sweep and repair CLIs. The opt-in float64 Gram solver is compared with direct SVD on tall, wide, weak-rank and repeated-row inputs and two GPU checkpoint replays.

geometry_procrustes_linearity.scope: The 17 in-sample summaries have notebook and rank-aware comparisons. The held-out fit chooses truncation with an inner document split and refits the affine map on all outer training documents. Both stages learn sink thresholds and means from their own fit documents.
